facts.fact: 队伍被拦在 hannerast 通向 Kanaan 的 Cynghal 关卡外，Tilde 躲在马车里不敢下车，因为外面正是军队扎营、Sanafin 死去的那片树林
facts.anchor: Our line of weary travellers had been halted at the Cynghal gate where the hannerast opened into Kanaan.

facts.fact: 一名马夫隔着车壁报信：叛军从河边来穿过城，占下外堡和半座城，其余仍在「黑王子」Isen 手里
facts.anchor: They’ve captured the bailey and half the city.

facts.fact: Tilde 概述 Cynghal 的围城战法——挖墙、投毒之外，最重的武器是恐怖，靠劫掠、亵渎、强奸与酷刑逼对手的前线作出反应
facts.anchor: They would pillage, desecrate, rape and torture to draw a response from their enemy’s front

facts.fact: 转过山谷路后她看见烟的来处：Cynghal 控制区内三堆尸体在焚烧，叛军旗上画着六辐车轮，所以烧的是城里人
facts.anchor: three mounds of bodies were burning in the Cynghal-held part of the city

facts.fact: 叛军据守的城区没有石墙，被一整条活荆棘围住，荆棘从银河南岸的林地一路越河穿城，粗得像人的身体
facts.anchor: The rebel-held city was encircled not by a wall of stone, but what looked like a tangle of living thorn.

facts.fact: 她认出这道荆棘就是他们寻而未得的魔法，也是当年裹住并护着 Sanafin 尸身的那种力量，而城里的叛军会用它
facts.anchor: the magic that shrouded and guarded my lover’s body in briars and thorns

facts.fact: 她家诸旗之外另有一面红旗：天鹅双翅高举、脖颈前伸，胸腔被剖开成空洞，里面一颗血心从肋骨间往外淌
facts.anchor: a red banner with a swan, wings up, neck reaching

facts.fact: 面对那面旗，Elise 先是沉默、手攥进口袋，最后粗声说出 Low King Alar 回来了，又压低声音叫她小心
facts.anchor: ‘Low King Alar has returned to us,’ she said roughly, then dipped her voice. ‘Be careful.’
